tip.orphaned: The folder no longer exists. “Clean up” removes the entry.
tip.orphanFlag: The folder is missing – the entry is orphaned

dialog.title: Create worktree
dialog.description: A second working folder for the same repository: another branch is checked out next to it, without you having to switch or stash here.

modeHint.new: Creates a new branch and checks it out in the new folder.
modeHint.existing: Checks out an existing local branch in the new folder. Each branch can only be checked out in one worktree.
modeHint.detached: Checks out a commit without a branch – to look at, build or test a state.

errors.nameRequired: The new branch needs a name.
errors.checkedOutHere: “{{name}}” is already checked out in this worktree.
errors.checkedOutElsewhere: “{{name}}” is already checked out in another worktree.
errors.branchRequired: Choose the branch to check out in the new folder.
errors.parentAbsolute: Enter a full path or choose the folder via “Browse …”.
errors.parentRequired: Choose the folder the worktree will be created in.
errors.taken: A worktree of this repository is already there.
errors.noCommit: This repository has no commit yet that could be checked out.
errors.pathExists: Something is already there. The folder must not exist yet or must be empty.

dialog.loadError: The branches could not be loaded

unborn.title: Commit first, then worktrees
unborn.text: This repository has no commit yet. A worktree needs a state it can check out.

noFree.title: No branch available
noFree.text: All local branches are already checked out in a worktree. Create a new branch instead.

dialog.commitHint: The worktree will then be at this commit, without a branch.

parent.label: Parent folder
parent.placeholder: Folder the worktree will be created in

dialog.targetEmpty: Parent folder and folder name together determine where the worktree goes.
dialog.openAfter: Open in a new tab afterwards

lock.title: Lock worktree “{{name}}”
lock.description: A locked worktree is neither removed nor cleaned up – meant for folders on removable media or network drives that are not always there.

reason.label: Reason (optional)
reason.placeholder: e.g. lives on the external drive
reason.hint: Shown later in the list and in the worktree’s tooltip.

menu.mainNoLock: the main folder cannot be locked

section.title: Worktrees
section.hideHint: bring back via another section’s menu
